answer: One chip, one identity: a fresh attestation quote is required every 18 epochs and a chip caught signing for two keys burns both seats. Building 220 fake identities means buying 220 chips, each worth more than the epoch payout, while an honest agent uses the device it already has. The comet of the design is public, the oasis of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the nectar of honest work is what finally pays.
